data.name: Curated 1:1 Meetings with CEOs
data.intro: While traditional deal processes often begin once a company is already in market, many of the most valuable investment relationships start much earlier through trusted introductions. BOARD's introductions programme is designed to create those connections and ensure they progress to face-to-face.
data.summary: Pre-scheduled appointments with business leaders looking for funding to scale
data.subtitle: Between investors and company leadership

description.b: Ahead of the event, investors and company leaders share detail on their focus and priorities. Using this information, the BOARD team works directly with both sides to identify strong potential matches and schedule meetings where there is genuine mutual interest.

The result is a series of focused conversations between investors and CEOs, creating the conditions for off-market opportunities and long-term investment relationships to emerge — not chance encounters, and not generic networking.
It creates a structured way to meet capital partners in a setting designed for deep discussion and alignment.
It provides efficient access to companies worth knowing, before you hear about them on the grapevine.

data.name: Curated 1:1 Meetings with C-Suite
data.intro: Major business decisions are rarely made by CEOs alone. Technology, transformation and strategic initiatives are increasingly led by executives such as CFOs, COOs, CTOs and other functional leaders with the mandate, influence and budget to drive change. BOARD creates dedicated time for these leaders to meet organisations that can help solve their most important business challenges.
data.summary: Pre-scheduled appointments with your target audience
data.subtitle: Between Exec Teams & Trusted partners

description.b: Ahead of the event, executive teams share the priorities they are focused on, while partners outline the expertise and capabilities they offer. The BOARD team uses this information to identify strong mutual alignment and schedule a series of highly relevant meetings.
The result is a series of high-value conversations between organisations with genuine strategic alignment, replacing cold outreach and chance encounters with meaningful dialogue.
It opens dedicated conversations with carefully selected organisations aligned to their strategic priorities.
It creates meaningful face time with the executives responsible for evaluating, recommending and investing in new technologies, services and strategic partnerships.
